name: Moldova
summary: Using drugs without a prescription, or holding a 'small amount' without intent to sell, is a contravention (fine or community service, Contravention Code art. 85). Larger amounts and any supply are crimes.

emergency.poisonControlNote: No national public poison hotline could be verified; call 112.

callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law is known. Medical staff are bound by confidentiality, but police may become involved; small-amount possession and use are contraventions, not crimes.
drugChecking: No drug checking service is known to operate in Moldova.

wikiCannabis.title: Wikipedia: Cannabis in Moldova (use and small-amount possession = administrative offence, art. 85)

wikiLegality.title: Wikipedia: Legality of cannabis (Moldova: decriminalised, no medical use)

wikiMush.title: Wikipedia: Legal status of psilocybin mushrooms (Moldova: psilocybin/psilocin listed)

un1971.title: INCB Green List: psychotropic substances under international control (1971 Convention)

lsd.note: UN Schedule I. A 'small amount' for own use is a contravention (fine or community service); the legal limit for LSD may be very low. More is a crime.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin and psilocin are listed. Small amounts for own use: contravention; larger amounts or growing to supply: crime.

dmt.note: UN Schedule I. Small amount for own use: contravention (fine or community service); more is a crime. Ayahuasca contains DMT.

mescaline.note: UN Schedule I. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime.

dox.note: DOB, DOM, DOC are UN-scheduled. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime.

nbomes.note: UN Schedule I. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime. Limits for potent drugs may be tiny.

2c-x.note: 2C-B and other 2C-x are UN-scheduled. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 are UN Schedule I. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime.

5-meo-xxt.note: Not UN-scheduled; whether 5-MeO tryptamines are on Moldova's national list was not verified.

cannabis.note: Use or a small amount without intent to sell: contravention (fine or community service). Larger amounts and growing to supply: crime. No medical cannabis.

ketamine.note: Prescription/veterinary anaesthetic; national control status was not verified.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is UN Schedule II. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime.

dxm.note: Not internationally controlled; pharmacy (OTC vs prescription) status in Moldova was not verified.

nitrous.note: No information found on nitrous oxide rules in Moldova.

amphetamines.note: UN-scheduled. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime. Prescription stimulants need a prescription.

mdma.note: UN Schedule I. Small amount for own use: contravention (fine or community service); more is a crime.

cocaine.note: Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime. The legal small-amount limit was not verified.

caffeine.note: Legal and not a controlled substance.

alcohol.note: Legal from 18; sale to minors is prohibited.

ghb/gbl.note: GHB is UN Schedule II. Small amount for own use: contravention; more is a crime. Status of GBL/1,4-BD not verified.

opioids.note: Heroin: small amount for own use is a contravention, more is a crime. Prescription opioids need a prescription; methadone substitution exists.

tramadol.note: Prescription-only medicine; whether possession without a prescription is penalised was not verified.

benzodiazepines.note: Prescription-only, UN Schedule IV; use without a prescription falls under art. 85 as a contravention.

maois.note: Pharmaceutical MAOIs are prescription-only. The status of harmala/Syrian rue was not verified; DMT in ayahuasca is controlled.
